boundary.note: Reusable Python repair patterns may persist; lived experience and identity continuity do not.

records.problem_signature: Import or test failure associated with incompatible dependency versions.
observed_evidence: Traceback and dependency manifest point to the same package boundary.
records.solution_pattern: Propose a scoped dependency adjustment and re-run the failing import or test.
applicability_limits: Observed traceback must match the package boundary
Lockfile or environment mutation requires consent
records.rollback_or_reversal: Record prior package versions and preserve the lockfile diff or environment rollback note.
records.verification_method: Re-run the failing import or test command and record the result.
